name: Symphonic Warrior Speeaker
spec_text:
Pendulum Effect: During the Main Phase: You can destroy this card in your Pendulum Zone, then place 1 "Symphonic Warrior" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone, except "Symphonic Warrior Speeaker". You can only use this effect of "Symphonic Warrior Speeaker" once per turn.
Monster Effect: You can target 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster you control; Increase its Level by 1, then Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Symphonic Warrior" monster from your hand, Deck or face-up Extra Deck. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck face-down the turn you activate this effect except WIND Synchro Monsters. You can only use each effect of "Symphonic Warrior Speeaker"once per turn.
